text:
alex: quick question — we've got a few prod sessions that are bouncing regions when latency probes failover. should header overrides (X-Region-Prefer / X-Region-Override) win over session affinity or vice-versa?

sasha: depends on semantics. X-Region-Override = admin forced pin, should always win. X-Region-Prefer = soft hint, should respect sticky cookie unless latency breach.

jordan: agreed. current gateway code treats any header as highest priority which causes sessions to jump. that breaks user sessions that expect state in a region-bound cache.

kai: suggestion: precedence order = admin-override header > cookie-session-affinity > routing-policy-hints > latency-failover. then have a decay/tombstone for overrides.

alex: tombstone? explain.

jordan: when an admin sets X-Region-Override we attach a short TTL paired with a "force: true" flag. after TTL expires, we revert to cookie affinity. avoids permanent pinning.

sasha: also need a mechanism for failover grace window. if latency probe flips region for a single probe, we should not evict cookie immediately. maybe require N consecutive probes or traffic-weighted decision.

kai: +1. propose config knobs per route:

```
route:
  id: /v1/generate
  affinity:
    mode: cookie
    cookie_name: rw_region
    ttl_sec: 900
  header_overrides:
    prefer_header: X-Region-Prefer
    force_header: X-Region-Override
  failover:
    min_consecutive_probes: 3
    cooldown_sec: 120
```

alex: that looks good. how do quotas interact? if a region quota is exhausted but user pinned via cookie, do we force fallback and drop cookie? or fail request?

sasha: prefer to fallback automatically to next region if quota exhausted but log a telemetry event: quota_fallback with fields: original_region, target_region, reason=quota. we should surface in console alerts.

jordan: implementation detail: routing decision graph should emit a final_decision with tags: {source: header|cookie|policy|latency|quota, history: [step1, step2]} for debugging.

kai: telemetry events to add: region_assigned, region_overridden, region_fallback, sticky_evicted. include route_id, user_id_hash, reason, probe_stats.

alex: UX ask for console: per-route PDP show current affinity mode + recent sticky_evicted rate. and allow manual revoke of X-Region-Override tombstones.

sasha: small note: need to sanitize X-Region-Override values — only allow whitelisted region codes and ACL for admins. else a client can force route to unavailable region.

jordan: also add header handoff when proxying to internal services: forward X-Region-Routed to downstream so logs correlate.

kai: tests: unit for precedence, integration with quota simulator, chaos test where region intermittently high latency and ensure cooldown logic prevents flapping.

alex: plan: implement precedence + tombstone + telemetry in gateway v2, feature-flag rollout to canary route /v1/generate, console patches to show affinity mode. target for canary next wednesday.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: gateway-v2 precedence-and-affinity -> canary (10% traffic) at 2026-03-25T04:00:00Z. Watch metric: sticky_evicted_rate, region_fallback_rate, avg_latency_by_region.

sasha: I'll add an RFC with config schema and a small ops playbook for manual revoke and quota bypass. ping @alex for review.

alex: thanks — I'll put a TODO in the runbook and add alerts. :thumbsup
